veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Sy het lank gevat om haar boeke
veranderings.na: Sy was lank besig om haar boeke
veranderings.rede: 'lank gevat' calques English 'took long'; 'lank besig' is the natural Afrikaans.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Nandi het in daardie selfde week ook stil geword in die klas.
veranderings.na: Nandi het in dieselfde week ook in die klas stil geword.
veranderings.rede: 'daardie selfde' is redundant, and the place phrase belongs before the verb group in Afrikaans word order.
'agterbly' is the natural verb for staying behind, and matches the last paragraph's 'agtergebly'.

veranderings.voor: Sy het gevra dat Lerato niks vir niemand sê nie.
veranderings.na: Sy het Lerato gevra om vir niemand iets te sê nie.
veranderings.rede: 'gevra dat ... niks vir niemand' is stiff; 'iemand gevra om ...' is the natural construction with the same meaning.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: net so stil en sy het
veranderings.na: net so stil, en sy het
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: alles gesê en sy het niks vir haarself gehou nie
veranderings.na: alles gesê, en sy het niks teruggehou nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma between two full clauses, and 'niks teruggehou nie' is the idiomatic way to say she held nothing back.

veranderings.voor: bang vir iemand in die huis
veranderings.na: bang vir iemand by die huis
veranderings.rede: 'by die huis' is the usual Afrikaans for 'at home'; 'in die huis' reads as physically inside the building.
'stopsit' is the more natural Afrikaans for putting an end to something; bare 'stop' leans on English.

veranderings.voor: saam met haar na die skoolhoof
veranderings.rede: 'saam met haar' after 'Sy het Nandi' leaves 'haar' ambiguous between the teacher and Nandi; 'saam' alone says the same without the unclear pronoun.

veranderings.voor: Lerato het buite op die bankie gewag met albei se tasse.
veranderings.na: Lerato het met albei se tasse buite op die bankie gewag.
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the 'met'-phrase comes before the place phrase and the final verb, not after the verb.
